Reviewer view: the judge's full reasoning

Ruling for the rider, and the reasoning in plain language for both of you. The SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02709 is refunded to the rider in full; no driver compensation is payable; the fee was collected as a rider-filed charge and is returned. The amount is read from the money block: fare_breakdown.total_charged 4.50 and fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee 4.50 (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). The monetary effect of SGD 4.50 is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so this provisional ruling executes automatically.

How to appeal: You may appeal once within 30 days (POL-GEN-04). A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 4.50 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

Draft 1 - sampled
Ruling for the rider, and the reasoning in plain language for both of you. The SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02709 is refunded to the rider in full; no driver compensation is payable; the fee was collected as a rider-filed charge and is returned. The amount is read from the money block: fare_breakdown.total_charged 4.50 and fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee 4.50 (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). The monetary effect of SGD 4.50 is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so this provisional ruling executes automatically. The fee cannot stand. POL-NS-01 requires all four limbs and limb (b) fails. The GPS trace EV-GPS-02709 (weight 1.0, 100% coverage, 86 fixes, no gap over 120 s) never places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for this zone class: his closest approach across the whole trip is 647.3 m and the count of qualifying in-radius fixes is 0. On that evidence POL-NS-02 finds the driver never arrived, and POL-NS-01 limb (b) is not met. The driver's own advocate concedes exactly this on the same numbers, so it is common ground. The 'I'm Here' event at 07:38:35 is a false arrival marker. The record shows the marker was the driver's own button press (platform_policy.arrival_marker BUTTON), and at that timestamp the trace placed him more than 300 m from the pin — indeed never closer than 647.3 m at any fix. Under POL-NS-05 the marker does not start the waiting clock; the clock is recomputed from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, and because no such fix exists anywhere in the trip, POL-NS-05(ii) applies: full refund of the cancellation fee, no driver compensation, and the false-arrival record set out in the referrals. Independently, POL-NS-06 gives the same result: effective in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds against the free waiting period in force of 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), a shortfall of 180 s. The driver's surviving points, and why they do not change the outcome. Limbs (a) and (d) are indeed met — there is an 'arrived' event at 07:38:35, and the trip was terminated by the driver at 07:43:37 under RIDER_NO_SHOW with no boarding event — but limbs (a) and (d) alone do not carry the fee; limb (b) is measured from the trace and fails. The 302 seconds between the arrival tap (07:38:37 wait-timer start) and the 07:43:37 cancellation is real time, but limb (c) and POL-NS-05 both measure the clock from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the tap, and there is no such fix; so the long wait does not save the charge. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider from the fee's point of view — the driver replied at 07:39:45, 30 seconds after the rider's 07:39:15 message, inside the 120-second window, so limb (b) is not met — but the rider does not need POL-NS-04, because the refund comes from POL-NS-02, POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06. POL-NS-12 does not apply: it covers only platform-confirmed GPS_AUTO arrival, and this record's marker is a driver button press. POL-NS-03 does not apply: the driver never came within 400 m of the pin, so no wrong-entrance finding and no pin-ambiguity goodwill arise. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip — no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against completed_trips_30d of 103 (rate 0.0097), below both limbs — so no compensation is withheld on that ground, and no POL-NS-09(d) escalation follows. The rider's surviving points are accepted as corroboration. The rider track carries 60 qualifying fixes at a mean 10.4 m and maximum 13.8 m from the pin, all stationary, inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius; this supports the rider's account and answers the driver's statement that the rider did not come, though the refund does not depend on it. The rider's observation that the driver wrote 'im here already' at 07:39:45 while the only admissible position record puts him at least 647.3 m away is accepted: the chat is consistent with the rider's version of events. One rider claim was removed by the referee and is not relied on: the argument that POL-NS-06(i) is closed by the absent traffic advisory was discarded because it cited the MISSING artifact EV-ADVIS-02709-01 (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) without naming the issue code. Nothing turns on it; the advisory is absent, so no accumulation of intervals under POL-NS-06(i) is available in any event, and the refund rests on the shortfall itself. Confidence is 0.95. The deciding fact — the driver's position — is carried by EV-GPS-02709 at weight 1.0, and no artifact below 1.0 carries it; the missing advisory is not the evidence for any deciding fact, and the trace is complete with no gaps, so POL-NS-08(a)–(d) impairment and POL-NS-09(e) are not engaged. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, POL-NS-05 resolves rather than leaves the arrival conflict, the counterparty-dispute counters are both 0, the anti-farming check does not trip, and no_show_disputes_30d is 1.
